# PakVisa Advisor

> AI-powered visa eligibility checker and travel tools for Pakistani passport holders. Check visa requirements for 70+ countries, compare destinations, estimate trip budgets, and track your visa application with WhatsApp reminders.

## Key Pages

- [/](https://pakvisa-advisor.vercel.app/) — Homepage: Visa checker, country grid, tools, and visa policy alerts
- [/uae](https://pakvisa-advisor.vercel.app/uae) — UAE Visa Guide for Pakistani Citizens
- [/saudi-arabia](https://pakvisa-advisor.vercel.app/saudi-arabia) — Saudi Arabia Visa Guide
- [/turkey](https://pakvisa-advisor.vercel.app/turkey) — Turkey Visa Guide
- [/malaysia](https://pakvisa-advisor.vercel.app/malaysia) — Malaysia Visa Guide

## Features

- Visa requirement checker for 70+ countries with Pakistani passport
- Country comparison tool (side-by-side visa, cost, safety comparison)
- Currency converter (PKR to any currency)
- Trip budget calculator with monthly cost breakdowns
- Visa Process Tracker with WhatsApp reminders (Pro feature)
- AI assistant (Sara) for visa questions
- Visa eligibility quiz
- PDF visa guide downloads

## API Endpoints

- `/api/countries` — Country data (visa types, requirements, costs)
- `/api/currency` — Currency conversion rates
- `/api/compare` — Country comparison data
- `/api/score` — Visa eligibility scoring
- `/api/assistant` — AI assistant (Sara) chat
- `/api/timeline` — Visa timeline tracker (Pro)
